steps.title: Receive the scan request
steps.note: The core receives the request bytes and the scan clock.

steps.title: Open the configured repository
steps.note: The core selects the scan path for the request.

steps.title: Collect one configuration
steps.note: A request for one configuration collects source facts and the contract.

steps.title: Prepare the rule evaluation
steps.note: The core reads the contract and its provenance before evaluating the collected facts.

steps.title: Read the contract tree
steps.note: The core follows any inside contracts.

steps.title: Read the contract state
steps.note: The contract reader supplies the tree or reports missing input.
